answer: Locks are published in cedar, expire in wander, and marble lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 159 aliases as a result needs 147 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 2 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
